response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack and distributed-systems breadth and even some geospatial domain exposure (GISCollective, FOSS4G talk), but he lacks current, substantial C++ or Rust experience — his C++ work was brief and over a decade ago, and his recent roles are entirely TypeScript/Node.js focused. Without demonstrated modern systems-level programming or routing/navigation pipeline experience, he is a weak match for this C++/Rust-centric routing tiling role.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS domain experience via GISCollective platform and FOSS4G conference talk
Deep distributed systems and low-latency service experience (Sociomantic: async I/O, fibers, high-throughput microservices)
Broad technical range and demonstrated ability to pick up new stacks (embedded, mobile, backend, D language)
concerns: No current C++ or Rust experience — only brief, decade-old C++ work and no Rust at all
No navigation/routing-specific systems or real-time traffic data integration experience
Recent career trajectory (last 5+ years) is almost entirely TypeScript/Node.js, diverging from the C++/Rust systems focus required

key_factors.factor: No routing/navigation pipeline or tiling experience
